_about: Dispatch ACTION = what this transmission does to the incident lifecycle. Emitted as parsed.dispatch_action. The parser stays STATELESS — it only TAGS the action. A future hub-side linker uses the tag to match supplements to a prior incident and set correlation_id on the envelope, so the GUI can surface a unified incident with the full unit assignment. The parser does NOT attempt cross-incident linking (it has no state for that).
default_note: If no action prefix is present, dispatch_action = 'initial' (a fresh dispatch).

actions.note: Adds a unit to an existing incident. Keep the existing top-level special_call bool for back-compat AND emit parsed.dispatch_action='special_call'.
Sends remaining/upgraded units to an existing incident (e.g. working-fire escalation). Currently unhandled — falls into incident_type today.

_extension_note: Other escalation language likely exists (Second Alarm, Third Alarm, etc.). Add as observed live. is_supplement=true marks any action a future linker should correlate to a prior incident.
